name: Disable Superfetch
description: Disables the SysMain (Superfetch) service to reduce background disk and memory activity.

description_i18n.en: Disables the SysMain (Superfetch) service to reduce background disk and memory activity.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Dienst SysMain, um unnötige Hintergrundfunktionen und Speicherbelastung zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le service SysMain afin de réduire l'activité du disque et la consommation mémoire en arrière-plan.

warnings.title: Service disabled
warnings.message: The background application loading feature is turned off and will not run automatically on boot

warnings.title: Service state change
warnings.message: Related Windows services may stop or restart briefly while the action runs

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Disables the Windows SysMain (formerly Superfetch) service by setting its startup type to Disabled This stops the system from pre-loading frequently used applications into memory
